questions.q_en: If February 7th, 2025, is Friday. What day is March 1st, 2025?
questions.solution_en:
As the given year is a leap year: the month of February will have 29 days.

2025 is not a leap year and so February has 28 days.

Now, the 7th, 14th. 21st and 28th will fall on Friday as February has 28 days.

So,

1st March is Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Saturday".

questions.q_en:
Study the given directions and answer the question.

'A12%B' means 'B is 12m to the south of A'

'A9&B' means 'A is 9m to the east of B'

'A3@B' means 'B is 3m to the west of A'

'A4>B' means 'B is 4m to the north of A'

'A!B!C' means 'A, B and C form an equilateral triangle'

'A-B-C' means 'A, B and C form an isosceles triangle'

What will be the length of line DC if the perimeter of triangle DEC is 37m in the given expression D - E - C 13 @ E 13 % A 24 > D 17 % F?
questions.solution_en:
It is given that,

'A12%B' means 'B is 12m to the south of A'

'A9&B' means 'A is 9m to the east of B'

'A3@B' means 'B is 3m to the west of A'

'A4>B' means 'B is 4m to the north of A'

'A!B!C' means 'A, B and C form an equilateral triangle'

'A-B-C' means 'A, B and C form an isosceles triangle'

The given expression is D - E - C 13 @ E 13 % A 24 > D 17 % F

Thus, we have:

E is 13m to the west of C.

A is 13m to the south of E.

D is 24m to the north of A.

F is 17m to the south of D.

D, E and C form an isosceles triangle.

Isosceles triangle is a triangle in which two sides have equal length.

The length of DE is 11m and the length of EC is 13m.

The perimeter of tringle DEC is 37m.

DC = 37 - (13+11) = 13m

So, the length of line DC is 13m.
